name: @gin-quin/codec
description: Very fast and fully typed binary serializer with support for unions.

scripts.deploy: bun run test && bun x jsr publish
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build source/index.ts --outdir dist --target browser --sourcemap=external && tsc source/index.ts --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist --target esnext --module preserve --moduleResolution bundler --skipLibCheck && perl -pi -e 's#(from "\./[^"]+)"#$1.js"#g' dist/*.d.ts
